subject: gk
question: What is one primary objective of disinvestment in public sector enterprises?

options.text: To increase government control over industries
To generate revenue for the government
To reduce the efficiency of public enterprises

solution:
The correct answer is __**To generate revenue for the government**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Disinvestment** is the process of selling or liquidating government stakes in public sector enterprises to generate funds.
 
• The primary objective of disinvestment is to **generate revenue for the government** to reduce the fiscal deficit and fund developmental programs.
 
• It helps the government meet its **budgetary requirements** without increasing taxes or borrowing.
 
• Disinvestment in Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs) is also aimed at **reducing the financial burden of loss-making entities** on the government.
 
• Proceeds from disinvestment are often used to invest in infrastructure, social welfare programs, or debt reduction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Strategic Disinvestment:**

 
 
• It involves selling a major portion of government shares in a PSE, along with the transfer of management control to private entities.
 
• Examples include the sale of Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) and Air India.
 
 
 
• **Fiscal Deficit:**
 
 
• It is the difference between the total revenue and total expenditure of the government in a financial year.
 
• Disinvestment helps reduce the fiscal deficit by generating non-tax revenue.
 
 
 
• **Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs):**
 
 
• These are companies owned and operated by the government, either fully or partially.
 
• PSEs play a crucial role in nation-building by contributing to economic development and employment generation.
 
 
 
• **National Investment Fund (NIF):**
 
 
• A fund where disinvestment proceeds are deposited.
 
• It is used for capital investment in infrastructure and financing social sector programs.
 
 
 
• **Privatization vs Disinvestment:**
 
 
• Privatization refers to transferring ownership and control entirely to private entities.
 
• Disinvestment involves partial or full sale of government stakes, but ownership may or may not be transferred.
